services.name: Paddle Boards
services.desc: A little workout and a lot of fun, our paddle boards are a great way to get up close and personal with Lowcountry nature. Our location on Skull Creek offers easy access to the water and beautiful scenery to explore. A Paddle Board Guide will go through proper paddle techniques and use of the board. You'll be a pro before you know it! We will always try to get you to the calmest waters for your enjoyment and ease of learning. Please arrive 20 minutes early for paperwork and brief paddling and route instructions.**Our Paddle Board rentals are by reservation only. Please call a day ahead for morning trips; for afternoon trips please give at least 4 hours

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Feeding or touching wild dolphins will cost you up to $20,000 and a year in prison. It is considered harassment and is illegal. They're naturally curious about humans and feeding them can put them in danger. Dolphins are extremely skilled at catching their own food so they don't need your picnic

services.name: Jet Skis
